description: Check, fill, import and export edu-sharing translation files (Angular JSON, metadataset .properties, mail templates).
view.areas.welcome:
No edu-sharing translation files were found in this workspace.
[Configure folders](command:eduI18n.configureRoots)
untrusted.description: In Restricted Mode, translations can only be viewed and checked; writing files and AI features are disabled, and the workspace settings for areas, variants and roots are ignored.
config.title: edu-sharing i18n
config.referenceLanguage: Language that translations are compared with. `de` also matches `de_DE`.
config.baseFileLanguage: Language of files without a locale suffix, such as `templates.xml` or `mds.properties`.
config.areas: Additional translation areas, or the replacement of a built-in area with the same `id`. Example: `{ "id": "customer", "format": "json-nested", "roots": ["customer/i18n"], "files": "{bundle}/{locale}.json", "localePattern": "[a-z]{2}" }`.
config.roots: Fixed root folders per area id, relative to the workspace folder. Areas without an entry are detected automatically.
config.exclude: Glob patterns of folders that are never searched for translation files.
config.variants: Sparse language variants. `base` is the locale a variant falls back to, `requiredWhen` a regular expression for base texts that need an own variant text, `forbidden` text the variant should not contain.
config.checks.ignoreSameAsReference: Texts that may be identical to the reference without being reported.
config.diagnostics.missing: How missing keys appear in the Problems panel.
config.diagnostics.missing.aggregate: One problem per file with the number of missing keys
config.diagnostics.missing.off: Not shown in the Problems panel
